## Features

- **New look:** a violet identity with a `▲ up` header, status dots and a highlighted selected row. Colors are skipped when `NO_COLOR` is set or `TERM=dumb`.
- **Latency at a glance:** each monitor in the list shows a trend of its last 16 checks, with failed checks in red and unusually slow ones in amber. Open a monitor to see a latency chart of its last 28 checks with the average, p95, max and failed count.
- **Heartbeat pulse:** each time the daemon writes a heartbeat, a pulse travels along the line under the header. Press `a` to turn the animation off or on for the session.
- **Uptime today in the header:** the share of time your monitors were up since local midnight, averaged across monitors, with the number of incidents when there were any. It replaces the monitor counts and is hidden when there is not enough data to measure. The line under it shows the hostname of the machine you are on.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/giulianotesta7/up/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0
